_note: Đề luyện TOEIC Reading tự biên soạn bởi TV3 (nhóm 8). Không sao chép đề thương mại. Đánh số câu 101–200 như đề thật; Part 6 đánh dấu chỗ trống trong đoạn văn bằng (số câu).
title: Đề luyện Reading tự biên soạn số 1
description: Đề Reading đầy đủ 100 câu (Part 5: 30, Part 6: 16, Part 7: 54) trong 75 phút. Nội dung tự biên soạn để luyện tập, không phải đề chính thức của ETS.

part5.q: Ms. Tanaka was praised for her _____ handling of the customer complaint.
part5.explanation: Trước danh từ handling cần tính từ: professional.

part5.q: All travel requests must be submitted _____ the end of the month.
part5.explanation: By + mốc thời gian = không muộn hơn: by the end of the month.

part5.q: Mr. Garcia asked that the reports be sent directly to _____.
part5.explanation: Sau giới từ to cần đại từ tân ngữ: him.

part5.q: Since opening its first store in 2019, Fresh Basket _____ to fourteen locations.
part5.explanation: Since + mốc quá khứ, hành động kéo dài đến hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành: has expanded.

part5.q: Because of the storm, the outdoor concert has been _____ until next Saturday.
part5.explanation: Postpone until = hoãn đến. Các từ còn lại không hợp nghĩa.

part5.q: The new accounting software allows staff to complete invoices more _____.
part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ complete cần trạng từ; more quickly là so sánh hơn của trạng từ.

part5.q: _____ the hotel was fully booked, the manager found a room for the visiting director.
part5.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề và hai vế tương phản → liên từ Although. Despite chỉ đi với danh từ.

part5.q: Ms. Weber will be in _____ of the training program while Mr. Ito is on leave.
part5.explanation: Cụm cố định be in charge of = phụ trách.

part5.q: The shipment _____ by the time the warehouse opens tomorrow morning.
part5.explanation: By the time + mốc tương lai → tương lai hoàn thành: will have arrived.

part5.q: Customers have responded _____ to the redesigned store layout.
part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ responded cần trạng từ positively.

part5.q: Employees who wish to work from home must first obtain _____ from their supervisor.
part5.explanation: Obtain approval from = xin được sự phê duyệt từ cấp trên.

part5.q: The interns prepared the market analysis by _____ without help from the senior staff.
part5.explanation: By + đại từ phản thân = tự mình: by themselves.

part5.q: The museum's gift shop is located _____ the main entrance.
part5.explanation: Next to = bên cạnh, chỉ vị trí. Between cần hai đối tượng.

part5.q: The _____ of the new branch office is expected to create sixty jobs.
part5.explanation: Sau The và trước of cần danh từ: the opening.

part5.q: All visitors are required _____ a badge while they are inside the factory.
part5.explanation: Be required + to V: are required to wear.

part5.q: The consultant's report contained several _____ recommendations for reducing energy costs.
part5.explanation: Trước danh từ recommendations cần tính từ; practical = thiết thực.

part5.q: Please call the help desk _____ you have trouble logging in to the system.
part5.explanation: Vế sau là điều kiện để gọi hỗ trợ → if.

part5.q: Ridgeway Motors is _____ known for the reliability of its delivery vans.
part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ known cần trạng từ: widely known.

part5.q: _____ the past five years, Ms. Novak has managed the company's European accounts.
part5.explanation: Over the past five years = trong suốt 5 năm qua, đi với hiện tại hoàn thành. Since cần mốc thời gian.

part5.q: To _____ a refund, customers must present the original receipt.
part5.explanation: Receive a refund = nhận tiền hoàn lại.

part5.q: The quarterly results _____ to shareholders at next Monday's meeting.
part5.explanation: Kết quả được trình bày (bị động) và next Monday là tương lai → will be presented.

part5.q: Our team found the instructions for the new printer extremely _____.
part5.explanation: Find + O + adj. Hướng dẫn gây khó hiểu → tính từ -ing: confusing.

part5.q: Tickets for the charity dinner must be purchased in _____.
part5.explanation: Cụm cố định in advance = trước.

part5.q: Applicants _____ résumés arrive after June 1 will not be considered.
part5.explanation: Résumés thuộc về applicants → đại từ quan hệ sở hữu whose.

part5.q: The city council voted to _____ the new zoning rules starting next year.
part5.explanation: Implement the rules = thi hành quy định. Complement/compliment/supplement sai nghĩa.

part5.q: The workshop is open to _____ new and experienced employees.
part5.explanation: Cặp liên từ both ... and.

part5.q: Mr. Hassan is the most _____ candidate we have interviewed for the position.
part5.explanation: The most + tính từ + danh từ. Qualified = đủ năng lực.

part5.q: Had the supplier informed us earlier, we _____ a different delivery date.
part5.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3 (Had + S + V3) → would have + V3.

part5.q: _____ its small size, the café attracts a large number of customers every day.
part5.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ its small size → giới từ Despite.

part5.q: The engineers ran a series of tests to make sure the bridge was structurally _____.
part5.explanation: Structurally sound = vững chắc về kết cấu.

part6.title: E-mail · Office move

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (133).
questions.explanation: Máy tính được bộ phận IT lắp đặt lại → installed.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (134).
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu your cần danh từ: cooperation.

part6.title: Notice · Library hours
part6.instructions: Questions 135-138 refer to the following notice.

passage.content:
Westfield Public Library

More than 1,200 residents completed it in March.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (137).
questions.explanation: Be reserved online = đặt trực tuyến; online là trạng từ đứng sau động từ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (138).

part6.title: Letter · Order confirmation
part6.instructions: Questions 139-142 refer to the following letter.

passage.title: Order confirmation
passage.content:
Dear Mr. Okafor,

Sincerely,

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (139).
questions.explanation: Has been + V3 (bị động hiện tại hoàn thành): has been received.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (140).
questions.explanation: Hết vải nên giao muộn → quan hệ kết quả: As a result.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that best fits blank (141).
options: Blue and black chairs can be shipped right away.
Please pay the invoice within ten days.
The chairs are assembled in our factory.
questions.explanation: Câu trước đề xuất đổi màu, câu đúng nêu màu có sẵn để giao ngay → liền mạch.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (142).
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu your cần danh từ; appreciate your patience = cảm ơn sự kiên nhẫn.

part6.title: Article · Local business
part6.instructions: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.

passage.title: Bakery opens second location
passage.content:
LAKEVILLE (May 8) — Golden Crust Bakery, a family-owned business known for its fresh bread, will open a second location on Harbor Street next month. The new shop will be (143) _____ larger than the original store on Main Street.

Owner Rosa Delgado said the bakery has outgrown its first location. "On weekends, customers often wait in line for thirty minutes," she explained. (144) _____.

The Harbor Street shop will also include a small café (145) _____ customers can sit and enjoy coffee with their pastries. Ms. Delgado plans to hire twelve new employees. Applications are being (146) _____ through the bakery's Web site until May 20.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (143).
questions.explanation: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn larger cần trạng từ: significantly larger.

options: The bakery stopped selling cakes last year.
Bread prices have fallen across the country.
Main Street will be closed for a parade.
The second shop should shorten these waits considerably.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (145).
questions.explanation: Thay cho nơi chốn café, sau là mệnh đề đầy đủ → where.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (146).
questions.explanation: Are being + V3 (bị động tiếp diễn): are being accepted.

part7.title: Text message chain · Delivery
part7.instructions: Questions 147-148 refer to the following text-message chain.

passages.content:
Ben Russo (9:12 A.M.): Hi Mei, the projector for this afternoon's client meeting hasn't arrived yet.
Mei Lin (9:14 A.M.): The rental company called. Their van broke down, so it will be about two hours late.
Ben Russo (9:15 A.M.): The meeting starts at 1:00. Is that cutting it close?
Mei Lin (9:16 A.M.): It should be fine. But just in case, I'll ask the IT team if we can borrow theirs.
Ben Russo (9:17 A.M.): Great idea. Thanks!

questions.q: Why is the projector late?
options: It was sent to the wrong address.
The rental company is closed today.
The order was placed too late.
A delivery vehicle had a problem.
questions.explanation: Mei viết: Their van broke down — xe giao hàng bị hỏng.

questions.q: At 9:15 A.M., what does Mr. Russo most likely mean when he writes, "Is that cutting it close?"
options: He is worried there may not be enough time.
He thinks the projector is too expensive.
He wants to cancel the meeting.
He needs help cutting some paper.
questions.explanation: Cutting it close = sát giờ; ông lo máy chiếu đến không kịp trước 1 giờ.

part7.title: Web page · Customer review
part7.instructions: Questions 159-161 refer to the following online review.

passages.title: Review of Harborview Hotel
passages.content:
Harborview Hotel ★★★★☆
Reviewed by Sandra P.

I stayed at the Harborview for three nights during a business trip. The location is excellent — the convention center is only a five-minute walk away. My room was clean and quiet, and the complimentary breakfast offered plenty of choices.

My only complaint is about the Wi-Fi. It was very slow in the evenings, which made it difficult to join video calls. When I mentioned this at the front desk, the staff moved me to a room closer to the router, which helped a lot. I would definitely stay here again.

questions.q: Why did Sandra P. stay at the hotel?
options: She was moving to the city.
questions.explanation: Bà ở trong một chuyến công tác: during a business trip.

questions.q: What problem did she have?
options: The hotel was far from the convention center.
questions.explanation: Phàn nàn duy nhất là Wi-Fi chậm vào buổi tối.

questions.q: What is suggested about the hotel staff?
options: They responded helpfully to a complaint.
questions.explanation: Nhân viên chuyển bà sang phòng gần router và việc này giúp ích → phản hồi tích cực.

part7.title: Article · Recycling program
part7.instructions: Questions 162-165 refer to the following article.

passages.title: City expands recycling program
passages.content:
GREENFIELD (April 2) — Starting in July, Greenfield residents will be able to recycle food waste along with paper and plastic. — [1] — Each household will receive a small green bin for food scraps, which will be collected every Tuesday.

The program was tested last year in two neighborhoods. — [2] — According to city officials, the amount of trash sent to the landfill from those areas dropped by nearly 30 percent.

The food waste will be turned into compost and offered free of charge to community gardens. — [3] — Residents who would like to volunteer at an information booth can sign up on the city's Web site.

"We hope this program will become a model for other cities in the region," said Mayor Ellen Vance. — [4] —

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The election of a new mayor
An expansion of a recycling service
questions.explanation: Bài báo nói về việc mở rộng chương trình tái chế sang rác thực phẩm.

questions.q: What happened in the test neighborhoods?
options: Less trash went to the landfill.
questions.explanation: Lượng rác đưa ra bãi chôn lấp giảm gần 30%.

questions.q: What will happen to the food waste?
options: It will become compost for gardens.
It will be burned for energy.
It will be sold to farms.
It will be shipped to another region.
questions.explanation: Rác thực phẩm được chuyển thành phân compost và tặng các vườn cộng đồng.

questions.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Booklets explaining which items can be placed in the bins will be mailed in June."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn nói về hướng dẫn cho thùng rác; vị trí [1] nằm giữa phần giới thiệu chương trình và câu mô tả thùng rác xanh, phù hợp nhất.

part7.title: Article · Company profile
part7.instructions: Questions 173-175 refer to the following article.

passages.title: Solar startup signs major deal
passages.content:
BRIGHTON (June 18) — SunLeaf Energy, a three-year-old company that designs solar panels for apartment buildings, announced yesterday that it has signed a contract with Harmon Properties. Under the agreement, SunLeaf will install panels on 40 of Harmon's residential buildings over the next two years.

SunLeaf's panels are lighter than traditional models, so they can be placed on older roofs without major structural work. The company says this reduces installation costs by up to 25 percent.

To meet the demand created by the contract, SunLeaf plans to double its workforce by the end of the year. Most of the new positions will be for installation technicians, and the company will provide on-the-job training.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.explanation: Bài báo nói về hợp đồng giữa SunLeaf và Harmon Properties.

questions.q: What is an advantage of SunLeaf's panels?
questions.explanation: Tấm pin nhẹ hơn mẫu truyền thống nên lắp được trên mái cũ.

questions.q: What is suggested about the new technicians?
options: They must have five years of experience.
They will be hired from Harmon Properties.
They will work only on weekends.
They will be trained by the company.
questions.explanation: The company will provide on-the-job training.

passages.title: Library reopens after renovation
passages.content: OAKDALE (February 3) — The Oakdale Business Library reopened on Monday after a four-month renovation. The project, completed by Carter Builders, added a new meeting room, brighter lighting, and twenty additional computer stations. The meeting room can be reserved free of charge by local business owners. Library director Mia Santos said that the work finished two weeks ahead of schedule and within budget.

passages.content:

From: Mia Santos
Date: February 5
Subject: Thank you

Dear Mr. Carter,

On behalf of the library staff, thank you for your excellent work. Visitors have already told us how much they like the new space. I did notice, however, that two of the new light fixtures in the reading area are flickering. Could someone stop by to look at them this week? Also, I have not yet received the final invoice. Please send it to our finance office.

Best regards,
Mia Santos
